info.title: Eternal Life Hospice — Coverage Lookup API
info.description: Check whether Eternal Life Hospice serves a given city in Ventura or Los Angeles County, California. Returns a structured yes/no answer with county, subregion, and a link to the city-specific hospice care page. No authentication required.

get.summary: Look up a city or list published city-page records
get.description:
Two modes:

**City lookup** (`city` parameter): Returns whether the specified city has a published service-area page. Matching is case-insensitive and tolerates missing diacritics (e.g. 'La Canada' matches 'La Cañada Flintridge'). If the city is not found in the published list, the response still returns HTTP 200 with served=false and a message directing callers to phone for confirmation.

**Full list** (`list=true` parameter): Returns all currently published city-page records in a single payload. The `total` value is the length of the returned `cities` array, not a fixed count. Published pages do not guarantee eligibility or clinical coverage for an individual address; call the listed phone number to confirm.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name to look up (e.g. 'Pasadena', 'Thousand Oaks', 'La Canada'). Required unless `list=true` is supplied.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Set to `true` to return all published cities in one call instead of looking up a single city. The response is cached for 24 hours.

200.description: Coverage check result (city lookup) or full city list (`list=true`). Check the `served` boolean for city-lookup responses; use the `cities` array for list responses.

served.summary: City is in the service area

value.subregion: San Gabriel Valley and nearby communities

not-served.summary: City is not in the published service area

value.message: Eternal Life Hospice does not have a published service-area page for “San Francisco”. Please call 805.953.7273 to confirm coverage — our service area across Ventura and Los Angeles counties may extend beyond our published city pages.

400.description: Missing or empty `city` parameter (when `list=true` is not supplied).

405.description: HTTP method not allowed. Only GET is supported.

served.description: Always true for this schema variant.

subregion.description: Subregion label used by ELH for the area.
subregion.example: San Gabriel Valley and nearby communities

pageUrl.description: Canonical URL for the city-specific hospice care page.

served.description: Always false for this schema variant.

city.description: The city name as supplied by the caller.

message.description: Human-readable explanation directing the caller to phone for confirmation.

subregion.description: Subregion label used by ELH for the area.

pageUrl.description: Canonical URL for the city-specific hospice care page.

cities.description: All currently published city-page records. Retrieve the live response for the current list.

total.description: Length of the cities array (published city-page records).

counties.description: Distinct counties in the service area, sorted alphabetically.
